methods.description: Multiply numerators and denominators, converting whole or mixed numbers first, and simplify the result. Use multiplication for a fraction of a quantity.
Replace division by a nonzero fraction with multiplication by its reciprocal; convert mixed/whole numbers first and work multiplication/division chains from left to right.
Work back from the result to find a missing fraction, undoing multiplication with division or division with multiplication, then check the original relationship.
